folds.text: A **subagent** is a helper with its own context window. It does a side job, like searching a big codebase, and sends back only a short summary. Your main conversation stays tidy.
Claude can delegate on its own when a task matches a subagent's description, or you can ask for one by name. Claude Code also has built-in helpers for read-only search and planning.
You can limit what a subagent may do, such as read-only tools. Subagents are Markdown files, so you can ask Claude to write one for you. Their work still counts toward your usage.
A **plugin** bundles extras to install in one go. It can add skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers. Plugins come from **marketplaces**, which are catalogues of plugins.
Run `/plugin` to browse and manage them. A plugin can run hooks and servers, so read what it will install first, and be careful with sources you do not know.

folds.prompt: Subagent or plugin? Tap the basket.

items.text: Search a huge codebase without filling my main chat
items.why: It works in its own window and returns a summary.
